envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: The held clarification is now carried by the amended payload concept.

payload.title: a resolved note's payload names its carrier
payload.body: The payload concept lists a note's fields as title, kind, topic, body and whatever it blocks. Once a note can end resolved, its whole-state payload also holds what carries it: the concept or unit it was resolved to. Payload stands in the closure of notebook, which the bound plan suggestions-as-notes realizes, so this amendment waits until that plan closes. Nothing built in the meantime is misled: the resolved-notes unit already stores the carrier.
